chapter: Minstrel show life and Ida Cox
title: Oxley's singing and Ida Cox's repertoire
summary: He sang specialties on the show; Ida Cox sang the same blues as Bessie and featured singer Annette Bailey.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well, I think I would keep changing the subject maybe, but since you, I know, sing so well and do a lot of singing with George Lewis' band, did you ever sing in any of those shows? Oh yeah, I used to sing. You would sing too?
I used to have my specialties, you know, like the band played the overture, you know, play overture. I used to sing maybe two or three numbers.
Would you still play your drums or get out in front and sing? I'd still play my drums.
Still play your drums. And sing. Put the mic by me, you know, me and I'd sing the same way.

Well, let's see if there's anything else about Ida Cox that I can ask you, or that you can remember, about her, what song she featured. I know she made quite a few old Paramount records and then, in the, about 1940 or so, along that time, she made a couple more in New York. That's right. She went there and sang once at a concert in New York. That's right. But do you remember what song she featured on the show or anything?

Well, I tell you now, she made a, she sang a lot of the same songs like Bessie sang. Yeah. You know, like I said Death Letter Blues, Pink Slip Blues, One Hour Mama and all those kind of numbers. She sang the same thing.
And you know, some pop songs, I mean, she sang.

Because, you see, we had another girl, I used to sing most of the pop tunes, they called Annette Bailey, a girl from Birmingham, Alabama. She was a nice singer too. I haven't, I don't know what happened to her, Annette, but she was a nice singer too.
And, well, Ida used to feature her too, you know.
You think Ida was older than Bessie or younger? Could you tell? I mean, I never can judge people's age.
I think Ida was a little older than Bessie.

I thought maybe she might be too. Yeah. She was a little older than Bessie. I didn't know. Did Ida ever use a microphone? I know Bessie ordinarily didn't bother with the microphone, had such a big voice. I never heard Ida Cox, but about, oh I did hear in New York at a club too, Cafe Society, with Edmund Hall's band. Yeah. She was there one winter, just part of the winter, maybe a month or so. She된 stuff
